verdict.rationale: Grok Build is itself a coding agent. Its docs describe delegating work to it through a fullscreen TUI, plan mode that drafts a plan for approval before editing, structured todo tracking, and background subagents that return summaries to the parent session. Community users corroborate that the agent performs well on real projects. missing for 10: detailed independent hands-on reports of end-to-end task delegation beyond brief anecdotal praise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The TUI provides a rich, mouse-interactive, fullscreen experience for coding with agents.
In plan mode the agent explores the codebase and drafts a plan for your approval before it edits anything.
Subagents are independent child sessions with their own context. They return a summary to the parent when finished.
Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.
Grok Build has had impressive performance in a couple of my projects. And fast.
